items.title: Repair Notion to GitHub transport and stale recovery
items.description: Complete the explicit Notion transport priority: Pending pages are materialized into canonical GitHub missions idempotently, durable health evidence is written, stale claims are recovered, and Pending becomes Synced only after the canonical mission state is pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Expired and orphaned claimed/running missions recover with durable evidence and never duplicate a mission file.
Notion transport remains idempotent and records configured/not-configured plus sanitized success/failure health evidence.
Notion Pending transitions to Synced only after the canonical mission commit is pushed.

items.title: Recreate control-plane review-integrity mission
items.description: Implement the explicit external review-integrity requirements as a new mission. The failed v3 mission remains immutable history. Require trusted external review artifacts and truthful report/commit provenance before archival.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed mission cannot self-approve and only a trusted external artifact may advance it.
Review transitions and verification/provenance evidence are durable and truthful.
The failed v3 mission is not modified.

items.title: Homepage public-page performance budget pass
items.description: Continue the explicit roadmap performance pass by splitting or deferring below-the-fold homepage work and adding deterministic bundle or performance-budget regression coverage. Do not deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: Below-the-fold homepage work is deferred or split without changing visible behavior.
A deterministic performance or bundle regression check covers the change.
Relevant tests, typecheck, lint, and build pass locally.

items.title: CSP nonce/hash-compatible preparation
items.description: Continue the explicit roadmap CSP hardening: inventory inline script/style requirements and add nonce/hash-compatible infrastructure with tests, without enforcing production CSP or breaking Next.js hydration.
acceptanceCriteria: Inline script and style requirements are documented from repository evidence.
Nonce/hash-compatible infrastructure is covered by tests.
No enforcing production CSP policy is enabled.

items.title: Reduce one reproducible lint warning family
items.description: Continue the explicit roadmap lint-warning reduction by fixing exactly one reproducible warning family while preserving behavior and tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one identified warning family is reduced.

manualBlocked: Real testimonials require human-supplied user consent and source material.
